senses.en_definition: To take action or measures to deal with a situation or problem.

messages.en: I'm so mad. I'm going to reply to him in that group right now!
Don't do anything in the heat of the moment. Let's read what he wrote again, then think about how to reply.
You're so lucky to have found a job so close to home!
I'm really grateful. It's only a ten-minute walk.
Let's just exchange gifts at Farah's place tomorrow, okay?
Sure! I've already wrapped my gift.
That zoo has sun bears, right?
Yep, I've checked the schedule. Want to go tomorrow morning?
